title: AVC-Reward: Event-Centric Audio-Video Consistency Evaluation
title_zh: AVC-Reward：以事件为核心的音视频一致性评估

paragraphs.en: As joint audio-video generation models become more capable, they can generate audio-visual scenes exhibiting three forms of complexity: multi-event composition , multi-layer audio mixture , and asymmetric cross-modal relations . However, current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks. They typically evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations, making them unsuitable for these increasingly complex scenes. We propose an event-centric evaluation framework that disentangles audio and visual events at the event level, analyzes each event independently, cross-validates relations across modalities, and aggregates the judgments into a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric . The metric assesses global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment, providing a general formulation for audio-video consistency evaluation across diverse generation settings and cross-modal relations. We instantiate the metric as AVC-Reward , a trainable audio-video reward model. To evaluate the agreement between automatic judgments and human perception across generation paradigms and relation complexities, we construct AVC-Benchmark, which is primarily built from diverse positive and negative samples generated by various types of audio-video generation models. AVC-Reward achieves state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment among automatic methods, provides interpretable rationales that localize failures, and improves the audio-video consistency of a joint generation model when used as an online reinforcement-learning signal. Project page: https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/
paragraphs.zh: 随着联合音视频生成模型能力的不断提升，它们能够生成呈现三种复杂度的视听场景：多事件组合、多层音频混音以及非对称的跨模态关系。 然而，当前的评估方法大多沿用了早期简单单向任务的指标。 这些方法通常将音视频片段作为一个整体进行评估，并依赖简单的预定义关系，因此不适用于这些日益复杂的场景。 我们提出一个以事件为中心的评估框架，该框架在事件层面解耦音频与视觉事件，独立分析每个事件，跨模态交叉验证事件间的关系，并将判断聚合为一个由粗到细的三级一致性指标。 该指标评估全局叙事协调性、事件级时间同步性以及细粒度属性对齐，为跨多种生成设置和跨模态关系的音视频一致性评估提供了通用形式化方法。 我们将该指标实例化为 AVC-Reward，一个可训练的音视频奖励模型。 为了评估自动判断与人类感知在不同生成范式和关系复杂度下的一致性，我们构建了 AVC-Benchmark，它主要由多种类型的音视频生成模型生成的多样化正负样本构成。 AVC-Reward 在自动方法中实现了与人类判断的最先进对齐，提供可解释的、能够定位失败点的推理依据，并且在作为在线强化学习信号使用时提升了联合生成模型的音视频一致性。 项目主页：https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/

paragraphs.en: Audio-video generation has evolved from unidirectional driving toward joint generation with increasingly strong generative capabilities. Earlier audio-driven video generation (e.g., Wav2Lip ( Prajwal et al., 2020 ) ) and video-to-audio generation (e.g., HunyuanVideo-Foley ( Shan et al., 2025 ) ) were centered on more constrained consistency relations: the former mainly focused on lip synchronization ( Chung and Zisserman, 2016 ) , while the latter mainly focused on simple temporal alignment ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) . In contrast, joint generation removes the constraint of a fixed modality, with recent models such as Veo 3 ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) , MiniMax H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) and Seedance 2.0 ( Seedance et al., 2026 ) extending this paradigm to richer and more complex scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 音视频生成已从单向驱动演进为联合生成，生成能力日益增强。 早期的音频驱动视频生成（如 Wav2Lip (Prajwal et al., 2020)）和视频到音频生成（如 HunyuanVideo-Foley (Shan et al., 2025)）以较为受限的一致性关系为核心：前者主要关注唇形同步 (Chung and Zisserman, 2016)，后者主要关注简单的时间对齐 (Iashin et al., 2024)。 与之相比，联合生成摆脱了固定模态的约束，近期的模型如 Veo 3 (Google DeepMind, 2025)、MiniMax H3 (MiniMax, 2026) 和 Seedance 2.0 (Seedance et al., 2026) 已将这一范式扩展到更丰富、更复杂的场景。

paragraphs.en: These richer audio-visual scenes exhibit three forms of complexity: multi-event composition , multi-layer audio mixture , and asymmetric cross-modal relations . First, a clip can contain multiple events that together form a complete scene, with several events potentially occurring at the same time. Second, its audio track can mix physical scene sounds with post-produced audio such as voice-over and background music, which instead support the video’s narrative or atmosphere. Third, audio and visual events need not follow a simple one-to-one relation: valid audio events such as off-screen sounds may lack direct visible visual evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 这些更丰富的视听场景展现出三种形式的复杂性：多事件组合、多层音频混合，以及非对称的跨模态关系。 首先，一个片段可以包含多个事件，它们共同构成一个完整场景，且多个事件可能同时发生。 其次，其音轨可以将物理场景声音与后期制作的音频（如画外音和背景音乐）混合在一起，而这类音频是服务于视频的叙事或氛围的。 第三，音频事件与视觉事件不必遵循简单的一一对应关系：有效的音频事件（如画外声音）可能缺乏直接可见的视觉证据。

paragraphs.en: However, evaluation methodologies have not kept pace with this evolution: the richer audio-visual content produced by joint models has made consistency evaluation more demanding. Current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks, where one modality was fixed and only a limited relation such as lip–speech or sound–action timing needed to be checked; accordingly, they often evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations such as semantic similarity or temporal synchronization. Multi-event composition makes such clip-level evaluation unreliable because different event relations are entangled; for example, ImageBind-based metrics ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ; Mao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) encode the audio and video within a clip or temporal window into a shared embedding space and measure their overall similarity, which can remain high when dominant semantics match despite a local event inconsistency. Multi-layer audio mixture further complicates evaluation: metrics such as Synchformer ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) predict an audio–video temporal offset from the mixed soundtrack without separating its layers. When physical sounds are mixed with voice-over or background music, sounds that should align with visible actions are evaluated together with audio that does not require such temporal correspondence, which can lead to an inaccurate consistency score. Complex cross-modal relations further challenge predefined matching rules; for example, AV-Align ( Yariv et al., 2024 ) matches audio onsets with visual-motion peaks and may therefore penalize a valid off-screen sound that lacks direct visual evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，评估方法并未跟上这一演进：联合模型生成的更丰富的视听内容使得一致性评估更具挑战性。 目前的评估大多沿用早期简单且单向任务的指标，在那类任务中，一种模态是固定的，只需检查诸如唇—语音或声音—动作时序等有限关系；因此，这些评估往往将一段音频—视频片段作为整体来评价，并依赖语义相似性或时间同步等简单的预定义关系。 多事件组合使得这种片段级评估不可靠，因为不同的事件关系相互纠缠；例如，基于 ImageBind 的指标（Girdhar et al., 2023; Mao et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2025）将片段或时间窗口内的音频和视频编码到共享嵌入空间中并测量其整体相似性，当主要语义匹配时，即使存在局部事件不一致，该相似度仍可能保持较高水平。 多层音频混合进一步增加了评估的复杂性：如 Synchformer（Iashin et al., 2024）等指标从混合音轨中预测音频—视频时间偏移，而不对其各层进行分离。 当物理声音与画外音或背景音乐混合时，本应与可见动作对齐的声音会与无需此类时间对应的音频一起被评估，这可能导致一致性评分不准确。 复杂的跨模态关系进一步挑战了预定义的匹配规则；例如，AV-Align（Yariv et al., 2024）将音频起始点与视觉运动峰值相匹配，因此可能会惩罚缺乏直接视觉证据的有效画外音。

paragraphs.en: To meet this need, we propose an event-centric evaluation perspective, in which the audio and video of each generated clip are first disentangled into individual events and analyzed independently before the final judgments. Under this perspective, we first separately extract and analyze audio and visual events, then cross-validate their relations across modalities, and finally aggregate the resulting judgments from coarse to fine. We formulate this final consistency assessment as a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric . Global narrative harmony assesses whether the audio and video form a coherent scene and narrative. Event-level temporal synchronization establishes event relations, checks event presence and temporal alignment, and marks audio events without visual evidence. Fine-grained attribute alignment verifies the attributes of matched events and assesses whether marked audio is plausibly an off-screen sound, voice-over, or background music. By disentangling individual events, distinguishing different audio sources, and explicitly validating their cross-modal relations, this metric can separately assess overlapping events, handle audio layers with different roles, and accommodate valid asymmetric relations, as illustrated in Fig. 1 .

paragraphs.en: Based on this event-level perspective, we implement the above three-level metric as a trainable audio-video reward model, named AVC-Reward , initialized from Qwen3-Omni-Thinking ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . AVC-Reward implements the metric through a five-stage structured reasoning chain consisting of audio(/video)-only analysis, cross-modal verification, and overall judgment. Its training data includes audio-video samples from different generation paradigms and models, with annotations from multiple expert MLLMs and human annotators, while its two-stage training procedure uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to cold-start the structured evaluation process and group relative policy optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to align the scoring with human preferences. Meanwhile, to measure the agreement between audio-video consistency metrics and human perception across generation paradigms and relation complexities, we construct an audio-video consistency benchmark, AVC-Benchmark . To our knowledge, it is the first audio-video consistency benchmark primarily built from diverse samples generated by various types of audio-video generation models.

paragraphs.en: We formalize audio-video consistency across generation paradigms with an event-centric, three-level metric designed to handle complex generated scenes.

paragraphs.en: Audio-video generation first developed through audio-driven video generation ( Prajwal et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) and video-to-audio generation ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Shan et al., 2025 ) , where one modality is fixed. Joint audio-video generation (JAVG) removes this constraint: early works either learned a joint generative process ( Ruan et al., 2023 ) or coordinated pretrained unimodal generators ( Xing et al., 2024 ) . Native JAVG then advanced toward open-ended generation, finer synchronization, and richer audio content, as represented by JavisDiT ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , Ovi ( Low et al., 2025 ) , UniVerse-1 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) . JAVG has further reached industrial-scale deployment through systems such as Veo 3 ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) , Seedance 2.0 ( Seedance et al., 2026 ) , and MiniMax H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , enabling the generation of more complex audio-visual scenes with multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixtures, and complex cross-modal relations, which makes audio-video consistency evaluation more demanding.

paragraphs.en: Existing audio-video consistency metrics and their limitations under modern joint audio-video generation are summarized in Table 1 . Early metrics target specific consistency relations: SyncNet measures lip–speech synchrony, AV-Align matches motion and audio peaks, and DeSync predicts temporal offsets. ImageBind, AVHScore, and JavisScore measure cross-modal similarity at clip, frame–audio, or temporal-window granularity. PEAVS and AVBench learn human preferences from manually created errors. AGAV-Rater and Beyond Time Shifts further learn from real V2A outputs. Recent analysis further shows that existing metrics focus on different aspects of consistency and exhibit low cross-metric agreement ( Sharma and Tapadiya, 2026 ) . Together, these methods remain tied to specific tasks or relations, making them insufficient for general audio-video consistency evaluation under the complexity of modern joint generation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的音视频一致性指标及其在现代音视频联合生成下的局限性总结于表 1。 早期指标针对特定的一致性关系：SyncNet 衡量唇部与语音的同步性，AV-Align 匹配运动与音频峰值，DeSync 预测时间偏移。 ImageBind、AVHScore 和 JavisScore 在片段、帧—音频或时间窗口粒度上衡量跨模态相似度。 PEAVS 和 AVBench 通过人工制造的误差学习人类偏好。 AGAV-Rater 和 Beyond Time Shifts 进一步从真实的 V2A 输出中学习。 近期分析进一步表明，现有指标关注一致性的不同方面，且指标间一致性较低（Sharma and Tapadiya, 2026）。 总而言之，这些方法仍局限于特定任务或关系，因此在现代联合生成的复杂性下，它们不足以用于通用的音视频一致性评估。

paragraphs.en: The complexities exposed by modern joint generation introduce three requirements for evaluation. Multi-event composition calls for event disentanglement , so that individual and overlapping events can be examined separately. Multi-layer audio mixture requires the evaluator to distinguish the roles of different audio events , as different audio sources can have different relations to the video. Asymmetric and diverse cross-modal relations further require establishing and verifying event-dependent cross-modal relations for individual events.
paragraphs.zh: 现代联合生成所暴露出的复杂性为评估提出了三项要求。 多事件组合需要事件解耦，以便能够分别考察单个事件和重叠事件。 多层音频混合要求评估者区分不同音频事件的角色，因为不同的音频源与视频可能具有不同的关系。 非对称且多样的跨模态关系进一步要求为单个事件建立并验证依赖于事件的跨模态关系。

paragraphs.en: Meeting these requirements requires an evaluator capable of jointly understanding audio-visual content and reasoning over different events and their relations. MLLMs with audio-video understanding capabilities can jointly perform these tasks within a unified reasoning process, making them a suitable foundation for audio-video consistency evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 满足这些要求需要一个能够联合理解视听内容，并对不同事件及其关系进行推理的评估器。 具备音视频理解能力的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）可以在统一的推理过程中联合执行这些任务，使其成为音视频一致性评估的合适基础。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, for more general and accurate evaluation, we argue that the judgments of the MLLM should be organized into an event-centric metric with three coarse-to-fine levels . Global narrative harmony first checks whether the audio and video are coherent across the full clip. Event-level temporal synchronization and fine-grained attribute alignment then move to the event level. They respectively assess the temporal alignment of each event and the consistency of audio-visual attributes within that event. Through event-level evaluation and detailed, independent verification of each event’s cross-modal relations, the metric addresses the higher evaluation demands above.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，为了更通用、更准确的评估，我们认为应当将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的判断组织成一个以事件为中心、具有从粗到细三个层级的指标。 全局叙事和谐首先检查音频与视频在整个片段内是否连贯。 事件级的时间同步和细粒度的属性对齐则进入事件层面。 它们分别评估每个事件的时间对齐情况以及该事件内视听属性的一致性。 通过事件级评估以及对每个事件的跨模态关系进行细致且独立的验证，该指标满足了上述更高的评估需求。

paragraphs.en: With this evaluation design in place, Section 3.2 defines the event-centric protocol and three-level metric, Section 3.3 constructs the corresponding training supervision, and Section 3.4 learns AVC-Reward through SFT and GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 在此评估设计的基础上，第 3.2 节定义以事件为中心的协议和三级指标，第 3.3 节构建相应的训练监督，第 3.4 节通过 SFT 和 GRPO 学习 AVC-Reward。

paragraphs.en: Following Section 3.1 , we define three-level consistency scores. Global narrative harmony ( S mac S_{\mathrm{mac}} ) measures agreement in narrative content, entities, environment, and affective tone. Event-level temporal synchronization ( S temp S_{\mathrm{temp}} ) measures event presence and the alignment of onset, offset, and duration under the appropriate cross-modal relations. Fine-grained attribute alignment ( S attr S_{\mathrm{attr}} ) measures attribute compatibility within verified relations, including sound–material agreement, lip-shape agreement with speech, and plausible responses to off-screen sounds. All three scores lie in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , with higher values indicating greater consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循第3.1节，我们定义三级一致性分数。 全局叙事和谐（ S mac S_{\mathrm{mac}} ）衡量叙事内容、实体、环境和情感基调方面的一致性。 事件级时间同步（ S temp S_{\mathrm{temp}} ）在适当的跨模态关系下衡量事件的存在以及起始、结束和持续时间的对齐。 细粒度属性对齐（ S attr S_{\mathrm{attr}} ）衡量经验证关系内的属性兼容性，包括声音与材质的一致性、唇形与语音的一致性，以及对画外声音的合理反应。 所有三个分数均位于 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 区间内，数值越高表示一致性越强。

sents.en: Following Section 3.1 , we define three-level consistency scores.

paragraphs.en: Our training data includes outputs from existing joint audio-video, audio-driven video, and video-to-audio generation models. paragraphs.en: Following the five-stage protocol in Section 3.2 , the annotation organizes modality-specific event analysis, bidirectional cross-modal verification, and the final coarse-to-fine judgment into a structured reasoning process. We construct the annotations using Gemini 2.5 Pro ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) and Qwen3-VL-Max ( Bai et al., 2025 ) as complementary annotators, with a silence detector providing auxiliary temporal cues. Each stage produces one structured record. The five structured records are concatenated and rewritten by Qwen3-235B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) into a single SFT target, ⟨ think ⟩ ​ 𝒞 ​ ⟨ /think ⟩ ​ { S mac , S temp , S attr , κ } \langle\texttt{think}\rangle\,\mathcal{C}\,\langle\texttt{/think}\rangle\{S_{\mathrm{mac}},S_{\mathrm{temp}},S_{\mathrm{attr}},\kappa\} , where 𝒞 \mathcal{C} preserves the five-stage reasoning order. After filtering, approximately 8k samples are retained for SFT. These samples provide explicit supervision for learning event-specific evidence and event-dependent cross-modal relations under the three-level metric. Complete reward-model prompts and input–output examples are provided in App. E .

paragraphs.en: The structured annotation pipeline provides scalable reasoning supervision, but its scores are limited by the perceptual capability of the annotation models and can accumulate errors across stages. We therefore introduce human annotations to calibrate the scores toward human judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化标注流水线提供了可扩展的推理监督，但其得分受限于标注模型的感知能力，并且可能在各阶段之间累积误差。 因此，我们引入人工标注，将得分校准至贴近人类判断。

paragraphs.en: We design a 39-label taxonomy over the three consistency dimensions, covering normal states and common failure types. Annotators assign applicable labels to each sample, grounding their judgments in explicit consistency evidence. We further construct a multi-annotator subset with both label annotations and independently assigned dimension scores. Based on this subset, Qwen3-235B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) maps each human-verified label record to ( S mac , S temp , S attr ) (S_{\mathrm{mac}},S_{\mathrm{temp}},S_{\mathrm{attr}}) and a diagnostic conclusion κ \kappa . This calibration produces approximately 10k human-calibrated samples for GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个一致性维度上设计了一套包含 39 个标签的分类体系，涵盖正常状态和常见失败类型。 标注者为每个样本分配适用的标签，并将其判断建立在明确的一致性证据之上。 我们进一步构建了一个多标注者子集，其中同时包含标签标注和独立分配的维度分数。 基于该子集，Qwen3-235B（Yang et al., 2025a）将每条经人工验证的标签记录映射为 (S_{\mathrm{mac}},S_{\mathrm{temp}},S_{\mathrm{attr}}) 以及诊断结论 κ。 这一校准为 GRPO 产生了约 1 万条经人工校准的样本。

paragraphs.en: After SFT cold start, we apply GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) on a 10k rollout set constructed from the human-calibrated data. The reward jointly preserves the required evaluation structure and aligns the three consistency scores with human judgment. paragraphs.en: We construct AVC-Benchmark to evaluate how well automatic audio-video consistency metrics align with human perception in realistic generation scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 AVC-Benchmark，以评估自动音视频一致性指标在真实生成场景中与人类感知的契合程度。

paragraphs.en: AVC-Benchmark is the first benchmark, to our knowledge, that primarily uses various types of model-generated audio-video data to evaluate the alignment between automatic consistency metrics and human perception. It contains samples from A2V, V2A, and JAVG models, together with a small set of controlled negatives added to balance the failure-case distribution and broaden the coverage of audio-video inconsistencies. Each sample is independently annotated by three annotators, providing human ground-truth scores on the three consistency dimensions defined in Section 3.2 . We evaluate each metric against these human scores using pairwise accuracy under different score-difference thresholds, Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient (SRCC), and Pearson’s linear correlation coefficient (PLCC).
paragraphs.zh: AVC-Benchmark 据我们所知是首个主要使用多种类型的模型生成音视频数据来评估自动一致性指标与人类感知之间一致性的基准。 它包含来自 A2V、V2A 和 JAVG 模型的样本，以及一小部分受控负样本，用于平衡失败案例的分布并扩大音视频不一致性的覆盖范围。 每个样本由三名标注者独立标注，针对第 3.2 节定义的三个一致性维度提供人类真值分数。 我们在不同的分差阈值下，使用成对准确率、斯皮尔曼等级相关系数（SRCC）和皮尔逊线性相关系数（PLCC），将每个指标与这些人类分数进行对比评估。

paragraphs.en: AVC-Reward consistently improves external audio-video consistency metrics across all prompt sets: IB-AV by 20.65 20.65 – 28.35 % 28.35\% , AV-Align by 18.78 18.78 – 59.47 % 59.47\% , JavisScore by 20.47 20.47 – 28.74 % 28.74\% , and AVHScore by 22.00 22.00 – 26.80 % 26.80\% . Moreover, although OmniNFT directly optimizes DeSync while ours does not, our DeSync gains remain comparable. These gains demonstrate strong generalization to unseen audio-video consistency metrics. CAVP changes by less than 1.7 % 1.7\% for both methods, indicating limited separation. As for other evaluate dimensions, because T-A, T-V, and A-V objectives are not perfectly aligned, stronger A-V optimization can slightly reduce text alignment. Within ImageBind, however, the AV gains exceed the observed TA/TV declines, while single-modality quality remains comparable at the OmniNFT level. paragraphs.en: We study general audio-video consistency evaluation under the challenges of multi-event composition , multi-layer audio mixture , and asymmetric cross-modal relations . We propose an event-centric coarse-to-fine three-level metric and instantiate it as AVC-Reward , trained with structured SFT and human-aligned GRPO. We further introduce AVC-Benchmark to evaluate human agreement across diverse audio-video generation models. AVC-Reward achieves the strongest human alignment among evaluated methods and, when integrated into OmniNFT, effectively improves audio-video consistency. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of event-centric consistency evaluation as both a reliable metric and an optimization signal for joint audio-video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在多事件组合、多层音频混合以及非对称跨模态关系的挑战下，研究通用的音视频一致性评估。 我们提出一种以事件为中心的由粗到细的三级指标，并将其实现为 AVC-Reward，通过结构化 SFT 和与人类对齐的 GRPO 进行训练。 我们进一步引入 AVC-Benchmark，以评估多种音视频生成模型与人类判断的一致性。 AVC-Reward 在所评估的方法中实现了最强的人类对齐，并且集成到 OmniNFT 中后，能有效提升音视频一致性。 这些结果表明，以事件为中心的一致性评估既可作为可靠的指标，也可作为联合音视频生成的优化信号，具有显著的有效性。

paragraphs.en: We construct the human-calibration source pool from JavisBench ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Its relatively large scale, paired ground-truth references, and broad content coverage provide a practical starting point for constructing diverse positive and negative examples when high-quality audio-video data remain limited. We sample 3.2k clips from each of five sources: JavisBench ground truth, Ovi-I2V, Ovi-T2V, HunyuanVideo-Foley, and an internal A2V model. The generated samples use the corresponding JavisBench inputs, covering JAVG, V2A, and A2V paradigms. These 16k clips form the initial candidate pool. We run the SFT model f 1 f_{1} eight times on each candidate to estimate sample difficulty and prioritize cases for which the model has not yet formed stable judgments. To preserve content diversity, we cluster ImageBind ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) audio-video embeddings into 300 clusters and sample across clusters. We also construct global-narrative negatives by swapping audio tracks across clusters. Finally, we sample original candidates and constructed global negatives at a 3:1 ratio to obtain the 10k rollout set used for GRPO.

paragraphs.en: Stages 1 and 2 first parse the two modalities independently. The audio branch separates speech, music, and other sound events, and records their scene context, speaker information, acoustic attributes, and timestamps. The video branch extracts the global scene, people, emotions, and timestamped visual events that may be relevant to audio.

sents.zh: 阶段 1 和阶段 2 首先独立解析两种模态。

paragraphs.en: Stages 3 and 4 then perform bidirectional event verification. For each audio event, audio-to-video verification searches its temporal window for supporting visual evidence and, when applicable, examines temporal alignment and fine-grained physical attributes. The absence of a visible source is retained as evidence rather than directly treated as an inconsistency, allowing later reasoning over off-screen audio and other asymmetric relations. Conversely, video-to-audio verification first determines whether a visual event should naturally produce sound. Naturally silent actions are preserved as reasonable silence, while sound-producing actions are checked for corresponding acoustic evidence, temporal alignment, and physical compatibility.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，阶段3和阶段4执行双向的事件验证。 对于每个音频事件，音频到视频的验证会在其时间窗口内搜索支持的视觉证据，并在适用时检查时间对齐和细粒度的物理属性。 可见源的缺失被保留为证据，而不是直接视为不一致，从而允许后续对画外音和其他非对称关系进行推理。 反之，视频到音频的验证首先判断一个视觉事件是否应该自然地产生声音。 自然无声的动作被保留为合理的静默，而会产生声音的动作则检查相应的声学证据、时间对齐和物理兼容性。

paragraphs.en: Stage 5 aggregates the modality-specific analyses and the two directional verification records. The evaluator also re-examines the original audio-video clip instead of relying only on intermediate annotations. paragraphs.en: The three evaluation levels require several non-trivial judgments, so we do not rely on a single unconstrained model response to construct the supervision. Instead, the annotation harness introduces explicit process controls around the underlying expert models. First, audio and video are analyzed independently, preventing early cross-modal information from directly biasing event discovery. Second, each detected event is converted into explicit timestamps and evidence records, and later checks operate on these records rather than restarting from an unconstrained global judgment. Third, verification is conditional: existence is checked before temporal or attribute compatibility, and inapplicable cases such as reasonable silence are explicitly bypassed. Fourth, the same relation is checked in both audio-to-video and video-to-audio directions, providing a cross-check for missing and hallucinated events. Finally, the aggregation stage receives all intermediate evidence but also re-examines the original audio-video clip, forming a final feedback check against errors propagated from earlier stages.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个评估层级需要进行若干非平凡的判断，因此我们不依赖单次无约束的模型响应来构建监督信号。 相反，标注流程在底层专家模型周围引入了显式的过程控制。 首先，音频和视频被独立分析，防止早期的跨模态信息直接偏置事件发现。 其次，每个检测到的事件都被转换为显式的时间戳和证据记录，后续检查基于这些记录进行，而不是从无约束的全局判断重新开始。 第三，验证是有条件的：先检查存在性，再检查时间或属性兼容性，对于不适用的情形（如合理的静默）则被显式跳过。 第四，同一关系会在音频到视频和视频到音频两个方向上分别检查，为遗漏和幻觉事件提供交叉校验。 最后，聚合阶段接收所有中间证据，同时还会重新审视原始音视频片段，从而对早期阶段传播的错误形成最终的反馈检查。

paragraphs.en: These controlled verification records are then transferred to AVC-Reward through both training stages. During SFT, the complete five-stage annotation trajectory, including single-modal analyses, bidirectional event verification, three scores, and the diagnostic conclusion, is used as the full supervision target. The model is therefore trained to reproduce the same staged verification process rather than learning only a direct mapping from the input clip to final scores. During GRPO, the structure reward explicitly rewards the presence of all five reasoning stages, while score distillation aligns the resulting judgments with human-calibrated scores. Together, the two stages preserve the verification procedure established by the annotation harness while transferring it from the cascaded expert pipeline into a single reward model. Whether this learned procedure leads to correct judgments is further evaluated through human alignment, training ablations, and qualitative cases.

paragraphs.en: In human annotation, we found that score-only judgments showed noticeable subjective variation and made disagreements difficult to verify. We therefore design a 39-label taxonomy that asks annotators to record explicit consistency states and failure types before score calibration, reducing unconstrained subjectivity while preserving observable information about event presence, timing, audio roles, and cross-modal relations. The taxonomy follows the same three dimensions as AVC-Reward: global labels cover narrative, affective, and environmental consistency; temporal labels separately describe physical interactions, speaker events, and music/rhythmic events, including missing, hallucinated, off-screen, and narrative-layer cases; fine-grained labels describe material, intensity, spatial, motion, and causal-response attributes. Table 7 summarizes the complete annotation space.
paragraphs.zh: 在人工标注中，我们发现仅依据分数进行评判存在明显的主观差异，且使分歧难以核实。 因此，我们设计了一个包含39个标签的分类体系，要求标注者在分数校准之前记录显式的一致性状态与失败类型，从而在保留关于事件存在、时序、音频角色以及跨模态关系的可观测信息的同时，减少不受约束的主观性。 该分类体系遵循与 AVC-Reward 相同的三个维度：全局标签涵盖叙事、情感与环境一致性；时间标签分别描述物理交互、说话人事件以及音乐/节奏事件，包括缺失、幻觉、画外以及叙事层的情况；细粒度标签描述材质、强度、空间、运动以及因果响应属性。 表 7 总结了完整的标注空间。

paragraphs.en: Annotators judge the three dimensions independently. Within each dimension, all applicable failure labels can be selected, allowing a clip to contain multiple inconsistency types or multiple affected events. paragraphs.en: Human annotations provide detailed categorical supervision, while AVC-Reward requires continuous targets for the three dimensions. We keep the overall training framework unchanged and replace its original audio-video reward DeSync ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) with AVC-Reward, using its overall score S AVC S_{\mathrm{AVC}} as the optimization signal, with reward-specific learning-rate and weight adjustments for comparable optimization strength. This isolates the effect of the proposed reward while retaining the original generation training setup.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将 AVC-Reward 作为优化信号进行评估，我们在 OmniNFT（Zhang et al., 2026a）的生成端强化学习框架基础上展开工作。 我们保持整体训练框架不变，将其原有的音视频奖励 DeSync（Iashin et al., 2024）替换为 AVC-Reward，以其总分 S AVC S_{\mathrm{AVC}} 作为优化信号，并对奖励特定的学习率和权重进行调整，以保证相当的优化强度。 这样既保留了原有的生成训练设置，又隔离出了所提奖励的效果。

paragraphs.en: OmniNFT jointly optimizes audio quality, video quality, and audio-video consistency rewards; under the original weighting, AVC-Reward therefore has a weaker relative optimization effect than the original DeSync reward. We use a two-stage schedule to compensate for this difference. In Stage 1, we retain OmniNFT’s original learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , set the AVC-Reward weight to 2.0, and train for 600 steps. In Stage 2, we reduce the learning rate to 1.5 × 10 − 5 1.5\times 10^{-5} and increase the other quality-reward weights, reducing the relative AVC-Reward weight to 1.2, and continue training for 275 steps. This setup provides generation-side RL validation of AVC-Reward while retaining a direct controlled comparison with the original OmniNFT training framework.

paragraphs.en: We construct AVC-Benchmark through three complementary steps. We first perform stratified sampling based on human label configurations to balance the coverage of major consistency and failure patterns, including global narrative conflicts, temporal offsets, missing or hallucinated audio, and fine-grained attribute mismatches. We then use ImageBind ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) to extract audio and video representations and cluster their joint embeddings, from which we sample across clusters to reduce semantic redundancy. Finally, we add explicitly constructed negative samples to strengthen the coverage of controlled failure cases that are less frequent in naturally generated data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三个互补的步骤构建 AVC-Benchmark。 我们首先基于人工标签配置进行分层抽样，以平衡对主要一致性与失败模式的覆盖，包括全局叙事冲突、时间偏移、音频缺失或幻觉，以及细粒度属性不匹配。 然后我们使用 ImageBind（Girdhar et al., 2023）提取音频和视频表示并对其联合嵌入进行聚类，从中跨簇抽样以减少语义冗余。 最后，我们添加显式构建的负样本，以加强对受控失败案例的覆盖，这类案例在自然生成的数据中出现频率较低。

paragraphs.en: Each benchmark sample is independently evaluated by three annotators following the 39-label protocol in Appendix B.3 . The benchmark annotators do not overlap with those used for the training set. Rather than directly assigning scores, annotators first inspect the three dimensions independently and select all applicable labels before providing the corresponding scores. This label-first protocol requires explicit checks of the relevant event existence, timing, attributes, and relation types, making the annotation process more traceable and reducing unconstrained score judgments. Annotators then assign a score from 0 to 1, with a step size of 0.1, for global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 每个基准样本由三名标注者按照附录 B.3 中的 39 标签协议独立评估。 基准标注者与用于训练集的标注者不重叠。 标注者并非直接打分，而是首先独立检查三个维度并选择所有适用的标签，然后再给出相应的分数。 这种“标签优先”的协议要求显式核查相关事件是否存在、时间、属性以及关系类型，使标注过程更具可追溯性，并减少无约束的分数判断。 随后，标注者针对全局叙事和谐度、事件级时间同步性以及细粒度属性对齐，分别赋予 0 到 1 之间、步长为 0.1 的分数。

paragraphs.en: The additional cases extend this evaluation to several other situations. The band case contains multiple instruments and vocals at the same time, testing concurrent event verification. The choir case changes from a conductor to the singers and requires the evaluator to verify different valid audio-video relations across the clip. The hammer case tests precise event-level temporal verification by introducing a clear delay between the visible impact and its sound. The concert-ending case tests fine-grained visual evidence for sound production: the performance has ended and the orchestra begins packing up and bowing, although the performance audio continues. Across these cases, AVC-Reward remains close to human judgments and provides conclusions that identify the relevant event or relation. The positive choir and band examples further show that complex but valid relations can still receive high consistency judgments.
